parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID as compound_chembl_id, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_records on activities.record_id and docs on compound_records.doc_id to retrieve publication provenance. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to require structures. Filter for target name 'fatty acid amide hydrolase 1' and target organism 'Homo sapiens' and standard_type 'IC50' and standard_units 'nM'. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
